title: Implement internal/acpclient package with direct acp-go-sdk usage
description:
**REQ**: REQ-GO-003, CON-001
**Design**: Section 3.1 — Drop go-adk-acpagent

**Scope**: Create `internal/acpclient/client.go` with:
- `Client` struct wrapping `*exec.Cmd`, `io.WriteCloser` (stdin), `*acp.ClientSideConnection`
- `Config` struct: Command, WorkingDir, Stderr, Logger
- `New(ctx, cfg)` — start subprocess, pipe stdin/stdout, create `acp.NewClientSideConnection` with a `noopClient`
- `Initialize(ctx)` — call `conn.Initialize` with `InitializeRequest`
- `NewSession(ctx, cwd)` — call `conn.NewSession` with empty `McpServers`
- `Close()` — close stdin, wait with timeout, kill if needed

Implement `noopClient` struct satisfying `acp.Client` interface: all methods return `MethodNotFound` except `SessionUpdate` which is a no-op.

**CRITICAL — suppress SDK "connection closed" noise**: `coder/acp-go-sdk` `Connection.shutdownReceive()` (connection.go:490) unconditionally logs `"connection closed", "cause", "peer connection closed"` at `slog.LevelInfo` via the logger set with `conn.SetLogger()`. This is expected behavior for acpdump (subprocess exits after session/new). Fix: set a discarding slog logger (or one at LevelError) on the connection so this INFO-level noise is suppressed. Do NOT pass the app logger to `conn.SetLogger()` unless it filters INFO from the SDK.

**Done-when**: `go build ./internal/acpclient/...` compiles; no "connection closed" noise on stderr during normal operation; unit test with mock subprocess passes Initialize+NewSession+Close lifecycle.
**Complexity**: Medium
**Risks**: `acp.Client` interface may have changed shape between SDK versions — mitigate by compiling against current `acp-go-sdk` version.
**Verification**: `go build`, `go vet`, test confirms no stderr noise
**Rollback**: Delete `internal/acpclient/`

title: Move acp-dump to baldaworks GitHub org and rebrand to acpdump
description:
## Pre-Authoring Analysis

The project `acp-dump` is a small Go CLI under `github.com/normahq/acp-dump` that inspects stdio ACP servers. It is being moved to the `baldaworks` GitHub org with a rebrand to `acpdump` (no hyphen). The project has an unnecessary dependency on `go-adk-acpagent` which wraps `coder/acp-go-sdk` — only three symbols are used (`NewClient`, `ClientConfig`, `SessionConfigValue`) for subprocess management + Initialize/CreateSession. The SDK already provides `ClientSideConnection` with these methods, so the wrapper can be dropped.

# acpdump Rebrand and Migration — Requirements Document

## 1. Overview

Move the `acp-dump` repository from `github.com/normahq/acp-dump` to `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump`, rebrand all references from `acp-dump`/`normahq` to `acpdump`/`baldaworks`, drop the `go-adk-acpagent` dependency in favor of direct `coder/acp-go-sdk` usage, and rename the local project directory.

**Actors**: Repository maintainer (Alexey Samoylov)

## 2. Scope

### In Scope
- REQ-REPO-001 through REQ-REPO-003: GitHub repo creation, remote update, directory rename
- REQ-GO-001 through REQ-GO-003: Go module path, import paths, dependency replacement
- REQ-CLI-001: Binary name change from `acp-dump` to `acpdump`
- REQ-NPM-001 through REQ-NPM-002: npm scope and omnidist config rebrand
- REQ-CI-001: GitHub Actions workflow updates
- REQ-DOC-001 through REQ-DOC-002: README, AGENTS.md documentation updates

### Out of Scope
- Migrating `go-adk-acpagent` itself to baldaworks
- Updating `@normahq/codex-acp-bridge` references in CLI examples (stays as-is per owner decision)
- npm publish of the new `@baldaworks/acpdump` package (separate release cycle)
- Archiving or redirecting the old `normahq/acp-dump` repo

## 3. Definitions and Glossary
- **ACP**: Agent Client Protocol — stdio-based protocol for AI agent communication
- **omnidist**: Cross-platform Go binary distribution tool with npm packaging
- **acpdump**: New project name (no hyphen), replaces `acp-dump`

## 4. Requirements

### Functional Requirements

**REQ-REPO-001** — Create GitHub repository
The system MUST create a new public repository `baldaworks/acpdump` via `gh repo create`.

**REQ-REPO-002** — Update git remote
The local git remote `origin` MUST be updated to `git@github.com:baldaworks/acpdump.git`.

**REQ-REPO-003** — Rename local directory
The local project directory MUST be renamed from `acp-dump` to `acpdump`.

**REQ-GO-001** — Go module path
The `go.mod` module path MUST change from `github.com/normahq/acp-dump` to `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump`.

**REQ-GO-002** — Go import paths
All internal Go import paths MUST be updated from `github.com/normahq/acp-dump/...` to `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump/...`. Affected files: `cmd/acp-dump/main.go`, `cmd/acp-dump/cmd/command.go`, `internal/apps/acpdump/inspect.go`, `internal/apps/acpdump/inspect_test.go`.

**REQ-GO-003** — Drop go-adk-acpagent dependency
The `github.com/normahq/go-adk-acpagent/v2` dependency MUST be removed. The three used symbols (`NewClient`, `ClientConfig`, `SessionConfigValue`) MUST be replaced with direct usage of `coder/acp-go-sdk` `ClientSideConnection` and subprocess management inline.

**REQ-CLI-001** — Rename CLI binary
The `cmd/acp-dump/` directory MUST be renamed to `cmd/acpdump/`. The Cobra `Use` field, example strings, and `Taskfile.yaml` MUST reference `acpdump`. Binary output name MUST be `acpdump`.

**REQ-NPM-001** — npm package scope
The omnidist npm package MUST change from `@normahq/acp-dump` to `@baldaworks/acpdump`. All platform-specific packages (`-linux-x64`, `-win32-x64`, `-darwin-arm64`, `-darwin-x64`, `-linux-arm64`) MUST follow the new naming.

**REQ-NPM-002** — omnidist configuration
The `.omnidist/omnidist.yaml` profile MUST be updated: tool name → `acpdump`, main → `./cmd/acpdump`, npm package → `@baldaworks/acpdump`, repository-url → `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump`. The `.omnidist/acp-dump/` directory MUST be renamed to `.omnidist/acpdump/`.

**REQ-CI-001** — GitHub Actions workflows
The `omnidist-release.yml` workflow MUST reference profile `acpdump`, npm package `@baldaworks/acpdump`, and use `acpdump` in all artifact paths and tar commands.

**REQ-DOC-001** — README update
The `README.md` MUST replace all `acp-dump` with `acpdump`, all `normahq` with `baldaworks`, and update GitHub URLs. The `@normahq/codex-acp-bridge` reference in examples MUST remain unchanged.

**REQ-DOC-002** — AGENTS.md update
The `AGENTS.md` MUST reflect the new binary name, directory paths, and build command.

### Non-Functional Requirements
None identified — this is a pure rename/refactor with no behavioral changes to the CLI.

### Constraints
- **CON-001**: The CLI MUST remain functionally identical after rebrand — same output format, same flags, same exit codes.
- **CON-002**: `@normahq/codex-acp-bridge` references in examples MUST NOT be changed.

## 5. Dependencies
- **DEP-001**: `gh` CLI must be installed and authenticated with permission to create repos in `baldaworks` org.
- **DEP-002**: `coder/acp-go-sdk` must provide `ClientSideConnection` with `Initialize` and `NewSession` methods.

## 6. Assumptions
- **ASM-001**: The `baldaworks` GitHub org exists and the maintainer has admin access. [ASSUMPTION — verified by owner request]
- **ASM-002**: The npm scope `@baldaworks` is available/registered on npmjs. [ASSUMPTION — not verified]

## 7. Risks

| ID | Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|----|------|-----------|--------|------------|
| RISK-001 | npm scope `@baldaworks` not registered | Medium | High | Verify with `npm org ls baldaworks` before publish |
| RISK-002 | `acp-go-sdk` client API insufficient for subprocess management | Low | High | Spike during Design to verify ClientSideConnection covers subprocess lifecycle |

## 8. Revision History

| Version | Date | Author | Changes |
|---------|------|--------|---------|
| 1.0 | 2026-09-01 | Prism/Specify | Initial requirements from owner request and clarification |
design:
# acpdump Rebrand and Migration — Design Document

## 1. Overview and Requirements Summary

This design addresses the migration of `acp-dump` from `github.com/normahq/acp-dump`
to `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump` with a full rebrand and dependency cleanup.

**Requirements covered**: REQ-REPO-001, REQ-REPO-002, REQ-REPO-003, REQ-GO-001,
REQ-GO-002, REQ-GO-003, REQ-CLI-001, REQ-NPM-001, REQ-NPM-002, REQ-CI-001,
REQ-DOC-001, REQ-DOC-002, CON-001, CON-002.

## 2. Current Behavior (Explorer Evidence)

### Subprocess lifecycle

`acpagent.NewClient` (client.go:130–203) performs:
1. `exec.CommandContext` to start the ACP subprocess with `StdinPipe`/`StdoutPipe`
2. Wire-logging wrappers around stdin/stdout (for debug mode)
3. `acp.NewClientSideConnection(c, wireWriter, wireReader)` — the actual SDK call
4. Background goroutines: `dispatchUpdates()` and `waitLoop()`

`acpdump` only calls:
- `client.Initialize(ctx)` → delegates to `conn.Initialize(ctx, InitializeRequest{...})`
- `client.CreateSession(ctx, cwd, configValues, mcpServers)` → delegates to `conn.NewSession(ctx, req)` then applies config values
- `client.Close()` → closes stdin, waits 200ms, kills process

`acpdump` passes `nil` for `configValues` (via `acpSessionConfigValues("")`) and
`nil` for `mcpServers`, so `CreateSession` just calls `conn.NewSession` with an
empty `[]acp.McpServer{}`.

### Callback interface

`acpagent.Client` implements `acp.Client` interface (callbacks). All callbacks
except `SessionUpdate` return `MethodNotFound`. `SessionUpdate` only logs at trace
level. Since `acpdump` never calls `Prompt`, no session updates are received.
**All callbacks are dead code for this use case.**

### Files touched by rebrand

| Category | Files | Pattern |
|----------|-------|---------|
| Go module | `go.mod` | `github.com/normahq/acp-dump` → `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump` |
| Go source | 4 files in `cmd/` and `internal/` | import path updates |
| CLI entrypoint | `cmd/acp-dump/` | directory rename to `cmd/acpdump/` |
| Taskfile | `Taskfile.yaml` | `BINARY_NAME`, `MAIN_PATH` |
| Workflows | `.github/workflows/omnidist-release.yml` | profile, NPM_PACKAGE, artifact paths |
| omnidist | `.omnidist/omnidist.yaml` + `.omnidist/acp-dump/` tree | profile key, npm config, dir rename |
| Docs | `README.md`, `AGENTS.md` | name/org references |
| Git | `.git/config` | remote origin URL |

## 3. Proposed Architecture

### 3.1 Drop `go-adk-acpagent` — Direct `acp-go-sdk` Usage (REQ-GO-003)

Replace `acpagent.NewClient`/`Initialize`/`CreateSession`/`Close` with inline
subprocess management using `coder/acp-go-sdk` directly.

**New internal package**: `internal/acpclient/client.go`

```go
package acpclient

type Client struct {
    cmd   *exec.Cmd
    stdin io.WriteCloser
    conn  *acp.ClientSideConnection
}

type Config struct {
    Command    []string
    WorkingDir string
    Stderr     io.Writer
    Logger     *slog.Logger
}

func New(ctx context.Context, cfg Config) (*Client, error)
func (c *Client) Initialize(ctx context.Context) (acp.InitializeResponse, error)
func (c *Client) NewSession(ctx context.Context, cwd string) (acp.NewSessionResponse, error)
func (c *Client) Close() error
```

**Key simplifications vs. acpagent.Client:**
- No `dispatchUpdates` goroutine (no prompt streaming needed)
- No `waitLoop` goroutine — just `cmd.Wait()` in `Close()`
- No `activePrompt` tracking
- No `PermissionHandler`
- No wire-logging wrappers (existing zerolog debug logging is sufficient)
- `acp.Client` callback interface: implement with a minimal no-op struct

The `acp.NewClientSideConnection` requires an `acp.Client` implementation. We
provide a `noopClient` struct that returns `MethodNotFound` for all methods.
This is exactly what acpagent does for all methods except `SessionUpdate` (which
only logs at trace level and is never triggered without `Prompt`).

**Decision**: Inline the subprocess lifecycle (~60 lines) rather than keeping a
500+ line dependency that includes prompt streaming, session resume, config option
negotiation, and terminal management.

**Tradeoff**: Loses automatic wire-logging of JSON-RPC frames. Acceptable because
acpdump's `--debug` flag already provides zerolog debug output, and the SDK's
built-in `SetLogger` provides JSON-RPC level logging.

**Alternatives considered**:
1. Keep `go-adk-acpagent` — rejected: unnecessary 500+ line dependency for 3 symbols
2. Fork relevant portions — rejected: more maintenance burden than inline

### 3.2 Module and Import Path Migration (REQ-GO-001, REQ-GO-002)

Mechanical find-and-replace:
- `go.mod` line 1: `module github.com/baldaworks/acpdump`
- Remove `github.com/normahq/go-adk-acpagent/v2` from require
- All `.go` files: `github.com/normahq/acp-dump/` → `github.com/baldaworks/acpdump/`
- Run `go mod tidy` to clean up

### 3.3 CLI Binary Rename (REQ-CLI-001)

- `cmd/acp-dump/` → `cmd/acpdump/` (directory rename)
- `cmd/acpdump/cmd/command.go`: Cobra `Use` → `acpdump [--json] -- <acp-server-cmd> [args...]`
- Example strings: `acp-dump` → `acpdump`
- `Taskfile.yaml`: `BINARY_NAME: acpdump`, `MAIN_PATH: ./cmd/acpdump`

### 3.4 npm/omnidist Rebrand (REQ-NPM-001, REQ-NPM-002)

- `.omnidist/omnidist.yaml`: profile key `acpdump`, tool name `acpdump`,
  main `./cmd/acpdump`, package `@baldaworks/acpdump`, repository-url updated
- `.omnidist/acp-dump/` → `.omnidist/acpdump/`
- All `npm/@normahq/acp-dump*` directories → `npm/@baldaworks/acpdump*`
- All `package.json` files: name, description, optionalDependencies, repository url
- All platform README.md files: references updated
- Binary names in `bin` fields stay `acpdump` (already aligned after CLI rename)

### 3.5 CI/CD Workflows (REQ-CI-001)

- `omnidist-release.yml`: `--profile 'acpdump'`, `NPM_PACKAGE: '@baldaworks/acpdump'`
- All `acp-dump` in tar/artifact paths → `acpdump`

### 3.6 Documentation (REQ-DOC-001, REQ-DOC-002)

- `README.md`: all `acp-dump` → `acpdump`, all `normahq` → `baldaworks` URLs
  **except** `@normahq/codex-acp-bridge` in examples (CON-002)
- `AGENTS.md`: paths, binary name, build command

### 3.7 Repository Operations (REQ-REPO-001, REQ-REPO-002, REQ-REPO-003)

Execution order:
1. `gh repo create baldaworks/acpdump --public --description "..."` (REQ-REPO-001)
2. All code changes committed
3. `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:baldaworks/acpdump.git` (REQ-REPO-002)
4. `git push -u origin main --tags`
5. Rename local directory after push (REQ-REPO-003) — this is done outside git

## 4. Data Flow

```
User CLI invocation
    → cmd/acpdump/main.go
    → cmd/acpdump/cmd/command.go (Cobra)
    → internal/apps/acpdump/inspect.go:Run()
    → internal/acpclient/client.go:New()
        → exec.Command → subprocess stdin/stdout pipes
        → acp.NewClientSideConnection(noopClient, stdin, stdout)
    → client.Initialize()
        → conn.Initialize(ctx, InitializeRequest{...})
    → client.NewSession()
        → conn.NewSession(ctx, NewSessionRequest{cwd, mcpServers:[]})
    → writeInspectHuman/writeInspectJSON → stdout
    → client.Close()
        → stdin.Close() → cmd.Wait()
```

## 5. Security and Trust Boundaries

- No change to trust model. The CLI spawns a local subprocess and reads its stdout.
- The `noopClient` callbacks reject all permission requests and file operations,
  maintaining the same security posture as the current acpagent wrapper.
- No network access, no credentials handling.

## 6. Verification Strategy

- `go build ./...` — compile check after all renames
- `go test ./...` — existing tests use `TestACPDumpHelperProcess` as a mock
  subprocess; tests verify Initialize, NewSession, error handling, and stderr
  isolation. These tests are unaffected by the refactor since they test at the
  `Run()` level.
- `grep -r "normahq/acp-dump" . --include="*.go"` — zero matches
- `grep "go-adk-acpagent" go.mod` — zero matches
- Manual: `go run ./cmd/acpdump -- opencode acp` for smoke test

## 7. Risks and Open Questions

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| `acp.NewClientSideConnection` requires background goroutine management | SDK handles this internally; `conn.Done()` channel available for coordination |
| npm `@baldaworks` scope may not exist | Verify before npm publish (separate release cycle, out of scope) |

No blocking open questions remain.
